entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Església de Sant Serni de Nagol is a church located in Sant Julià de Lòria, Andorra, that was constructed in the 11th century. Significant renovations were done to the church in the 17th and 18th centuries. It was registered as a heritage property by the Cultural Heritage of Andorra on 16 July 2003. It contains some of the earliest known works of Romanesque art in Andorra.
